valuation.key_issue_notes: First appearance of Spider-Boy (Amalgam character, a fusion of Spider-Man and Superboy). This issue is part of the Amalgam Comics crossover event between Marvel and DC.
valuation.rarity_notes: Part of a limited Amalgam Comics crossover event, making it a notable collectible for fans of both Marvel and DC.
valuation.analysis_notes: The comic is clearly identified as Spider-Boy #1 from Amalgam Comics, published in April 1996, as indicated by the 'APR 96' on the cover. Its condition is estimated to be Very Fine+ to Near Mint-, with only minor corner blunting and surface wear.
